role: Bounded exact complete-second-public-law witness screen across all three newly available L=2 winding classes
question: For one prospectively cost-selected positive-first-mass private error in each new winding class, does either fixed relation-free action yield a complete second public law different from the matched base at the same complete first record?

hypotheses.null_within_selected_matrix: The three selected candidate errors have the same complete conditional second public law as the base under both actions.
hypotheses.witness: At least one of six candidate/action cells has positive exact total-variation distance from its matched base law. This witnesses only the selected ideal conditional law, not a class-wide, full-IID, or risk effect.

source_basis: R6AF remediated D4 public binary charge interface and J6L/J6M paper-normalized ideal periodic L=2 orbit
J8C all 54 new eight-edge same-flux supports, positive exact selected-first masses, winding and projector-cost fields
J7Z base all-plus complete second laws and J8B full-public-record signed-projector/Walsh integrity method
J7L earlier six-edge trivial-winding controls; these are not numerically pooled with the present new supports
fork_classification: The three winding classes are independent, reversible in-scope diagnostics. Cover each with the minimum one candidate under both frozen actions, rather than asking a human to rank them. Choose solely by the J8C projected first-projector term count, breaking ties lexicographically by loop edges, before any new second-law output. Equality for one representative does not close its entire class. L=3 is a dependent geometry branch blocked by missing orbit/instrument pins, not an alternative action to rank.
frozen_model: Paper-normalized ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit and R6AF IID red-X physical channel, p_Z=0. Private physical errors are fixed supports, never decoder inputs. The complete first public flux/charge/vacuum record is observed before action; its charge is all zero and has positive exact mass for all four errors. The relation-free public red-edge action is fixed to [0] or [1,30,32,34,35] before the action-conditioned complete second public record. Only the hidden initial red-X support changes; orbit, geometry, first record, public action, second observation interface and exact comparison remain matched. No noisy round, new fault, posterior prior, logical score or policy is introduced.

matrix.selection_rule: Within each of the three J8C winding classes, minimize projected_exact_first_terms, then lexicographically minimize loop_red_edges_private. This rule uses only previous cost/topology, never the new second law.
matrix.design: Four errors (base plus one pre-cost-selected candidate in each class) crossed with both fixed actions: eight exact complete-second-law cells, six candidate/base contrasts. At each error/action reconstruct every eligible second charge bit, all parity moments over variable bits, and the full normalized binary public law. Exact base laws must replay J7Z. All three winding branches run within the one combined cap; no favorable class is selected after observing a law.
matrix.estimand: Exact total-variation distance between each selected candidate and base complete second-public law at the same positive first record and same action.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact selected error/first-record/action cell on the fixed ideal L=2 orbit; no Monte Carlo unit or uncertainty interval.
matrix.integrity: Hash-pin all inputs and runner before/after, verify cost-selection tie-break, first masses, common complete first and action-conditioned second flux, charge/vacuum exclusivity, operator commutation and normalization. Account for all 22 eligible second sites, retain deterministic bits, require each variable one-site bit to be exactly fair, and reject any negative rational Walsh probability. Replay both base laws exactly against J7Z; stop on any cap or pin failure.

acceptance: Exactly the frozen cost-selected one-error-per-winding-class matrix plus base and both actions; all eight cells either exact or the entire comparison censored on a failed gate
All 22 second sites audited per cell, all exact laws normalized and nonnegative, and both base complete laws replay J7Z
Report all six exact candidate/base total-variation values, including nulls, with the one-representative-per-class scope explicit
No class-wide null, full-IID information, unconditional logical risk, noisy JIT, policy or threshold claim

outcomes.positive_witness: Report the finite selected-record second-law witness and locate which winding/action cells differ; next register a restricted-support information or additional-support confirmation before any broader inference.
outcomes.all_equal: Report only the six selected representative/action nulls; other members of every winding class remain untested and may require a separately costed within-class matrix.
outcomes.censored: On pin, mass, flux, one-site, algebra, Walsh, replay, CPU or term-cap failure, release no complete-law comparison and diagnose the earliest unsupported gate.

stop_rule: Stop after the eight registered exact cells or the first failed gate. No adaptive new errors, alternate first records, action, geometry, IID posterior, logical score, history, arm or bootstrap.
